metadata.question: Was surface water present in the Alvord Desert basin, Oregon, on June 29, 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Dynamic World (DW) for surface water presence. DW is daily at 10 m and includes a 'water' class. Location is Alvord Desert basin, Oregon. Date: June 29, 2025. 2. Masking: No cloud mask needed because DW is pre-processed and surface-water class is reliable. 3. Logic: If any pixel classified as water (class 0) within a reasonable buffer around the playa center, return A. If 0 valid pixels after clipping (unlikely), return C2. If collection empty, return C1. If result is None/NaN, return C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time geom = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.55, 42.55]).buffer(15000) # Alvord playa basin date = '2025-06-29' # 2. Dynamic World collection dw = ee.ImageCollection('GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1') \ .filterBounds(geom) \ .filterDate(date, date) if dw.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No DW image for 2025-06-29.") print("C1") else: img = dw.first().select('label') count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('label').getInfo() if count == 0: print("No valid pixels.") print("C2") else: water = img.eq(0) # DW class 0 = water waterCount = water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=geom, scale=100, maxPixels=1e9).get('label').getInfo() print(f"Water pixels: {int(waterCount)}") print("A" if waterCount > 0 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
geom = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.55, 42.55]).buffer(15000)  # Alvord playa basin
date = '2025-06-29'

# 2. Dynamic World collection
dw = ee.ImageCollection('GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1') \
       .filterBounds(geom) \
       .filterDate(date, date)

if dw.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No DW image for 2025-06-29.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img = dw.first().select('label')
    count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                             geometry=geom,
                             scale=100,
                             maxPixels=1e9).get('label').getInfo()
    if count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        water = img.eq(0)  # DW class 0 = water
        waterCount = water.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                        geometry=geom,
                                        scale=100,
                                        maxPixels=1e9).get('label').getInfo()
        print(f"Water pixels: {int(waterCount)}")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if waterCount > 0 else "<answer>B</answer>")
